description: This Java source file defines the 'QueryThings' class, which is a command object used for searching 'things' in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes properties for filters, options, fields, and namespaces, methods for JSON serialization/deserialization, and several factory methods for instantiation.

classes.name: QueryThings
classes.description: An immutable command class for querying 'things' with optional filters, fields, options, and namespaces, supporting JSON serialization/deserialization.
